**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **What we checked:** SOW §§ 3.0 (MSL Responsibilities), 4.0 (IBM Responsibilities), 6.0 (Purchase of Products), 8.1 (IBM Parts / Nominated Suppliers), 13.0 (Inventory), plus full-document searches for "exclusive/exclusively", "sole supplier/sole source", "all of its requirements", "shall not purchase from any third party", second/alternate sourcing, and volume-commitment language.
- **Result:** The only hits on "exclusive" are unrelated (exclusive remedy, entire-agreement, server-location language). § 6.0's "IBM agrees to purchase Products" is order-driven and expressly does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product absent authorization — it is not a requirements contract and does not prevent IBM from sourcing elsewhere.
- **Direction check:** The directed-sourcing provisions (§ 3.0(5) and § 8.1(b) — MSL must buy from IBM Nominated Suppliers on IBM-specified terms) bind the counterparty and operate in our favour, so they are not flagged.
